name: Service principal holding Owner role on a subscription
description: A service principal has been granted the Owner role at subscription scope. Service principals authenticate with static secrets or certificates, which are routinely leaked into source code, CI logs, and developer workstations. Owner on a subscription allows modifying RBAC, so a compromised SP secret gives an attacker a path to escalate to tenant-wide control. Service principals should hold the least privilege required - typically Contributor or a custom role - and never Owner.
